The lessons will be taught in English when possible but some aspects can also be explained to you in Italian when you have difficulties. I have taught English to Italian speakers for nearly ten years and I understand the typical difficulties that Italians have when learning English and can help you overcome these obstacles.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Exams
pro_course_detail.description:
If you're preparing for a Cambridge, TOEFL, IELTS or a school/university exam I can help you with guided lessons specifically for the exam you intend to take. 
My exam preparation course is aimed at not only teaching you the correct grammar constructions but also how you can pass the exam. 
Each type of exam has it's own specific differences and it's vitally important you prepare yourself for the actual exam you intend to take. 
The course is designed to work on your weaker areas first then as you get closer to the exam date to concentrate more on practicing with previous exam papers so by the time your exam arrives you have the knowledge and the skills to have the best chance to pass the exam

pro_course_detail.title: B1 to C1 Level Booster Course
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you stuck or blocked at a good level of English but struggling to reach fluency?
This course is a mix of grammar, speaking and listening aimed at getting students over that difficult barrier that many hit. 
Typically this is for students that have reached B1 or B2 but don't have the tools to finish the job. 
This is a very common situation that many students find themselves in but there is a way out so don't panic, get in touch!

pro_course_detail.title: Cambridge Exam Preparation lessons from a specialist teacher at all Cambridge levels up from A2 - C2
pro_course_detail.description:
If you are taking any of the Cambridge exams then you need specialised lessons from an experienced teacher, not only to help you reach the required level in all skills, but also to prepare you correctly for the exam.
Many students that have difficulty passing the Cambridge exam find that even though their skills were sufficient, they weren't properly prepared for what to expect in each part of the exam. Or they didn't allow enough time for each part of the exam, meaning they weren't able to demonstrate their skills to the fullest of their ability. 
What I can offer you is a comprehensive course of lessons, starting from the initial assesment of your level, to the final preparations, so that you maximise every minute during the test.
I've been preparing students for the Cambridge exams for over 12 years and helped students pass at every level, including C2. 
If you are intending to take one of the Cambridge exams then it would be my pleasure to help you reach your goal.

In class, we will cover a range of topics that are pertinent to the business world, including making presentations, negotiating deals, writing professional emails and reports, and engaging in formal and informal conversations. With my experience in teaching business English to a diverse range of professionals, I am confident that you will gain the skills and confidence necessary to succeed in your professional endeavors. So, join me in this journey of discovery, and let us work together to improve your business English communication skills and open doors to new opportunities.

In addition to error correction, I like provide more advanced alternatives to the simpler language you are already using correctly.
I give reading and listening exercises for homework so that we have interesting topics to talk about in the following lesson.
